```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

fb <- cfg$feedback
cm <- attr(fb, "comments")
scales_fb <- attr(fb, "scales")
items_fb <- unique(fb$item)
r_fb <- max(fb$round)
num <- function(v) sub("\\.?0+$", "", formatC(round(v, 2), format = "f", digits = 2))
cap <- function(s) paste0(toupper(substring(s, 1, 1)), substring(s, 2))
n_items_txt <- if (length(items_fb) == 1) "the item" else paste0("the ", length(items_fb), " items")
share_txt <- paste0(format(100 * cfg$threshold), "%")
denominator <- if (cfg$relative_to == "points") {
  "the number of points of the rating scale"
} else {
  "the range of the rating scale"
}
with_comments <- nrow(cm) > 0
```

Thank you for taking part in round `r r_fb` of this Delphi study. This
document summarises the answers of the panel on `r n_items_txt` that will
be rated again in the next round.

For each item, you will find the median rating of the panel and the
middle half of the ratings, from the first to the third quartile: half of
the experts gave a rating within this interval. A narrow interval means that
the experts largely agree, a wide one that their opinions are divided. The
panel is considered to have reached consensus when the width of the
interval does not exceed `r share_txt` of `r denominator`.
`r if (with_comments) "The comments written by the experts are reported anonymously, as they were written."`

Please read this feedback before giving your ratings in the next round. You
may confirm or revise your previous ratings. If your rating differs markedly
from those of the panel, you are encouraged to explain your reasons in a
comment.

```{r items, results = "asis"}
for (it in items_fb) {
  rows <- fb[fb$item == it, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("\n# Item ", it, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (!is.na(rows$statement[1])) {
    cat(md_escape(rows$statement[1]), "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  out <- data.frame(
    Indicator = cap(rows$indicator),
    `Rating scale` = vapply(rows$indicator, function(i) {
      paste0("from ", scales_fb[[i]][1], " to ", scales_fb[[i]][2])
    }, character(1)),
    Median = num(rows$median),
    `Middle half of the ratings` = paste0("from ", num(rows$q1), " to ", num(rows$q3)),
    Consensus = ifelse(rows$consensus %in% TRUE, "Yes", "No"),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  cat(md_table(out), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n")
  if (with_comments) {
    ci <- cm[cm$item == it, , drop = FALSE]
    cat("**Comments from the panel**\n\n")
    if (nrow(ci) == 0) {
      cat("No comments were written on this item.\n\n")
    } else {
      for (k in seq_len(nrow(ci))) {
        cat("* ", md_escape(ci$comment[k]), "\n", sep = "")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}
```
